rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a publishing company or publishing house, especially one that publishes books.

example.english: The publisher finally brought out a new book.
example.traditional: 出版社終於出咗本新書。
example.jyutping: ceot1 baan2 se6 zung1 jyu1 ceot1 zo2 bun2 san1 syu1

rows.note: Use this for the commercial publisher as a business, rather than focusing on the physical publishing house.

example.traditional: 呢間出版商主要做教科書。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 ceot1 baan2 soeng1 zyu2 jiu3 zou6 gaau3 fo1 syu1

rows.note: Use this when the publisher is specifically an individual publishing professional or decision-maker.

example.english: This publisher personally selects works by new writers.
example.traditional: 呢位出版人親自揀選新人嘅作品。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 ceot1 baan2 jan4 can1 zi6 gaan2 syun2 san1 jan4 ge3 zok3 ban2
